scenes.headline: How a small model learns to drive a robot arm
scenes.sub: CaPtain post-trains Qwen3.5-4B into a code-as-policy robot agent
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Winch! CaPtain turns a small open model into a robot policy that writes Python. Here's how it learns which line mattered.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Train the code-writer itself, over low-level primitives with no grasp skill, and credit each request by how much it moved a simulator critic's predicted success.
scenes.say: No grasp skill, no frontier model. Train the code writer itself, and credit each request by how much it changed the predicted success.

steps.say: The policy sees the instruction and two cameras, thinks, and writes one Python cell.
The cell calls twenty-two low-level primitives: look, segment, measure, move. There is no grasp function.
A move becomes a straight sweep, solved with inverse kinematics, that stops at first contact.
Every call writes a short receipt of what physically happened, and the loop runs again, up to sixty times.

left.title: Outcome-only RL
items: Every request shares the episode's result
A look and a dropped bowl share blame
left.say: Plain outcome reinforcement learning gives every request the same credit, so a look and a dropped bowl share the blame.

right.title: Simulator critic
items: Reads object poses the policy never sees
Credits the change in predicted success
right.say: CaPtain trains a critic on the simulator's hidden state, and credits each request by the change it caused.

scenes.title: Per-request credit
scenes.text: credit = V(next state, t) - V(state, t)

parts.note: chance of success before the request
parts.say: The critic scores the chance of success before the request.

parts.note: after it, at the same index t
parts.say: Then after it, read at the same request index, so time passing earns nothing.

parts.note: looks get zero, grasps get the credit
parts.say: A request that only looks changes nothing physical and gets zero. Grasps and placements get the credit.

scenes.title: Held-out LIBERO host success
scenes.say: The base model solves nothing. Fine-tuning on frontier-agent trajectories reaches fifty-five point four percent. Reinforcement learning reaches seventy-three point eight.

scenes.label: of random reachable poses the IK solves within five seeds
scenes.note: 86.7% from the first seed alone, my re-implementation
scenes.say: I re-ran its inverse kinematics on two thousand poses. Restarting from five seeds solves ninety-nine point two five percent.

scenes.text: Score the next state at the same index, and give stopping its own signal: a success critic never rewards finishing.
scenes.say: Score the next state at the same index. And give stopping its own signal, because a success critic never rewards finishing.

recap: Python cells over 22 primitives, receipts back
Credit is the change in predicted success
scenes.say: Python over low-level primitives, critic credit per request, and a small model that drives the arm itself.
